title: Arc sweep
subtitle: Design a clear signal, a reachable response, and a useful opening.
summary: The boss anchors one end of an attack and sweeps a dangerous arc across the arena.
overview: An arc sweep rotates a wide threat around the boss. It works when the pivot and edge are visible, the safe region remains reachable, and the committed motion creates a reliable opening.
learning: Tune the signal, the pivot and arc, response time, and recovery.

demo.title: Test the pattern
phaseDescriptions: The boss marks the pivot and the starting edge of the arc.
The arc rotates at a fixed rate while the player moves into the safe region.
The sweep ends and the boss returns smoothly to its ready pose.
demo.reducedMotion: Autoplay is disabled by the reduced-motion setting. Use the timeline slider to inspect the loop.
demo.diagramDescription: A looping diagram of arc sweep. The boss signals the pattern, the player responds, and both return smoothly to their starting positions.

steps.title: Is the signal specific?
steps.body: Show the pivot, start angle, direction, and moment the rotation becomes fixed.

steps.title: Is the response reachable?
steps.body: Measure the nearest safe route from both close and distant positions.

steps.title: Is the opening useful?
steps.body: Keep the boss committed long enough for the player to reposition and act.

mistakes.title: Hidden rule
mistakes.body: If the signal does not reveal the pivot and arc, the hit feels arbitrary.

mistakes.title: Wrong scale
mistakes.body: If timing is tested only at one upgrade level, the pattern can become trivial or unavoidable.

designNotes.title: Match visuals and collision
designNotes.body: The visible threat must match the active hitbox in space and time.

designNotes.title: Start with ordinary abilities
designNotes.body: Keep one response available with abilities the player already has.

designNotes.title: Retest upgrades
designNotes.body: Check movement, range, damage, and invulnerability against every phase.

story.title: Make the arena support the rule
story.body: Use enough clear floor to read the arc edge; remove props that hide the pivot.

adaptation.title: Respect player upgrades
adaptation.body: Test the strongest available build. If an attack is blocked, make the immunity clear and preserve another useful response.

distinction.title: Name the exact pattern
distinction.body: A sweep rotates an edge around a pivot. A spin is centered on the boss; a beam may keep tracking.

lensNotes.body: The cue reveals what will happen, where, and when.
The shape of danger defines the player’s possible routes.
A readable response turns pressure into a decision.
More coverage or duration earns a clearer opening.

examples.body: A blade travels on a clean arc; the fixed trajectory lets the next safe region be anticipated.
Long sword sweeps overlap into changing arcs, showing how animation and arena spacing define coverage.
